commit_message: Prevent scalar env overrides from replacing config branches
pr_title: Prevent scalar env overrides from replacing config branches
pr_body:
Fixes #12.

This prevents scalar environment overrides such as `AO_APP=replacement` from replacing an existing nested config branch like `app.name`. It also rejects attempts to descend through an existing scalar value when setting nested keys.

Verification:

```bash
uv run pytest tests/test_config.py -q
```

Result locally: `7 passed`.
